title: 神经符号驱动：基于规则推理的驾驶VLA模型
summary: 提出神经符号驱动框架，利用经典规则规划器提取规则化推理轨迹，监督驾驶VLA模型。该方法确保推理与运动生成因果耦合，在模拟基准上显著降低ADE和失误率。
summary_en: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a framework that supervises driving VLAs with rule-grounded reasoning traces from classical rule-based planners, ensuring causal coupling between reasoning and motion generation, achieving significant improvements on a simulator benchmark.
